name: Suralink
description:
Suralink is the agentic automation platform for accounting professionals and their clients, unifying Request-to-Review workflows for 1,300 firms and 800,000+ client users. Our MCP server allows you to query your Suralink engagement data in plain language - outstanding items, client activity, request status - directly from Claude. Ask Claude which clients need attention today. Ask it to summarize what's been uploaded in the last week. Ask it which outstanding items are still waiting on a client response. It pulls from live Suralink data and answers in plain language, so your team skips the manual checking and gets back to the work that actually requires their expertise.
Nothing about your Suralink workflow changes. PBC, testing, workpaper prep, tie-out, and review all stay exactly where they are, in one workspace instead of five disconnected steps. Suralink has always sat at the front door of client data. Now, the AI that acts on that data lives there too.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Suralink to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Suralink to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.suralink.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Suralink MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Suralink lists 28 MCP tools, including export_organization_users, get_department, get_engagements, get_organization_user, get_organizations, get_request_item, get_request_item_annotations_bulk, get_request_item_detail, get_request_item_files_summary, get_request_item_history, get_request_items_for_engagement, and get_request_list_state.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Suralink?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Suralink in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Suralink requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Suralink is developed by Suralink. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
